name: OpenMAIC
description: Open Multi-Agent Interactive Classroom — Get an immersive, multi-agent learning experience in just one click
one_liner: A one-click virtual classroom where several AI characters, like a teacher and classmates, interact with a student together, instead of one single chatbot tutor.
buyer: An online school or e-learning platform that wants a more engaging, classroom-like AI learning experience than a plain 1:1 chatbot tutor.
business_use_cases: An online tutoring platform licenses the engine to offer a 'virtual classroom' upgrade that feels more social than a 1:1 chatbot.
A corporate training company uses the multi-agent classroom format to make compliance or onboarding courses less boring.
A university or bootcamp pilots it as a free supplementary study-group simulator for students without a study partner.

money_ideas.idea: A white-labeled classroom product licensed per-seat to schools or e-learning platforms.
A consumer app charging per course or subject unlocked.

steal_this: Build one polished 'virtual study group' experience for a single popular exam, like SAT vocabulary, and sell it as a $10/month add-on this weekend.
